_comment: 受信技能用法提示, 按 task 注入 LLMPlanner payload 的 task.usage_hints。数值唯一来源是 calibration/success_semantics.csv 的 M2 标定行 (AGENTS rule 2: 阈值不得写死在代码里)。这些是'怎么用技能'的标定约定, 不是成功判定信息 — 判定仍由 S5 独立验证。M4 发现: 剧本 planner 把 place 释放高度 (bin z +0.12m) 写在步骤里, LLM 看不到该约定导致投放点错误 → place 超时 (seeds 1001/1002 复现)。

PutRubbishInBin.place: release target: XY = container base frame XY, Z = container base Z + 0.12 m (M2 calibrated drop height, calibration/success_semantics.csv:PutRubbishInBin). Releasing lower hits the rim or bounces out.
PutRubbishInBin.grasp: target_xyz: use the object's current WORLD pose_xyz (re-read after any world change).

PickUpCup.grasp: target_xyz: use the cup's current WORLD pose_xyz; the skill lifts it 0.30 m clear (LIFT skill constant, success_semantics.csv:PickUpCup).
PickUpCup.done: call control:done only after verified progress shows holding + displacement.
